kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
wire.summary: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.

wire.title: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
wire.summary: The Trump administration filed an emergency relief request with the high court earlier in October asking for the construction to continue while a lawsuit over the plan moves forward.

wire.title: Thomas Massie files articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
wire.summary: The articles accuse Hegseth of "high crimes and misdemeanors," including for waging war against Iran in violation of the War Powers Resolution.

wire.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
wire.summary: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

wire.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
wire.summary: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.

wire.title: Congress is back after GOP's midterm defeat. And, Trump appoints new chief of staff
wire.summary: Republicans have just weeks left of control of Congress. Here's what to expect. And, Trump has appointed Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, signaling his readiness to confront his opposition.

wire.title: Why a South Korean city is turning to a U.S. college to outsmart AI?
wire.summary: Through civic participation and liberal education, South Korean educators hope to "quietly stitch the fabric of our democracy…before it unravels beyond repair."

wire.title: Democrats won big on issues like immigration. But ICE still has the money
wire.summary: Following Tuesday's "blue wave," Democrats have vowed to reign in ICE's power. What could they actually accomplish?

wire.title: On wild Cumberland Island, a land swap proposal stirs controversy
wire.summary: Visitors, ecologists, park rangers and residents all love this wild barrier island off the coast of southern Georgia. But they have different ideas of how to best protect it.

wire.title: He was diagnosed with cancer. Then he was told he lost his Medicaid
wire.summary: Health clinics and organizations advocating for poor and working-class Nebraskans say the rollout of Medicaid work requirements has been rife with problems.

wire.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
wire.summary: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

wire.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
wire.summary: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.

wire.title: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
wire.summary: Trump made the claims, without evidence, on Truth Social on Monday.

wire.title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people

wire.title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
wire.summary: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.

wire.summary: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.
